purpose: Teach: 見舞わ/陥り/放つ/つながら/かけ離れ/一転/産む/傷つける

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店が大雨に見舞われたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the shop got hit by heavy rain.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly concerned. Speaking to a close friend with ease. Quiet reflective tone, like sharing something that just happened. Warm eye contact.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、忙しさで疲労に陥りそうだから休もうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you look like you're about to crash from all the busyness — let's take a break, okay?
lines.style: Caring and direct, the tone of someone who's been watching. Soft firmness without being bossy. A little maternal. Slight pause before the suggestion to soften it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューがお客様の心に響く香りを放つわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the new menu — that aroma really draws people in, doesn't it?
lines.style: Genuine delight in the discovery. Warm, slightly conspiratorial, like sharing something she's noticed. Relaxed pace. A touch of pride in the observation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ネットがつながらないとレジが大変ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, when the internet goes down the register becomes a real nightmare, doesn't it?
lines.style: Dry, understated humor. A knowing shake of the head. Not complaining, just noticing the absurdity. Light and matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、看板の絵が実物とかけ離れてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the picture on the sign is nothing like the real thing, is it?
lines.style: Playful observation with a hint of wry amusement. Soft laugh underneath. Shared joke between friends. No edge, just noticing something funny together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、雨から一転して晴れたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the rain cleared right up — look, sunshine again.
lines.style: Brightened tone, like relief and small joy. Gentle wonder at the shift. Looking outward, inviting Aoi to notice too. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、犬が子を産む寸前だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer just told me her dog is about to have puppies.
lines.style: Delighted, like holding good news carefully. Soft excitement, not loud. Speaking to Aoi with the warmth of sharing something sweet. Thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の繊細さを傷つける接客はしないを心掛けようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's be mindful not to hurt customers with careless service — their feelings matter.
lines.style: Tender guidance, the voice of someone teaching gently. Not a lecture, more an invitation to remember. Quiet conviction. Speaking with kindness, not correction.
